test_dataframe_isin_with_list: test DataFrame.isin() to filter values against a list of allowed items
test_dataframe_isin_with_dict: test DataFrame.isin() with a column-to-values dict for selective column filtering
test_dataframe_isin_with_series: test DataFrame.isin() against a Series to match values across columns
test_dataframe_isin_with_dataframe: test DataFrame.isin() against another DataFrame for element-wise matching
test_dataframe_isin_empty_input: test DataFrame.isin() returns all False when passed an empty list or empty Series
